next_step: Closed-lost — re-engage H2 2025 if hyperscaler lock-in becomes problematic
closed_reason: Procurement selected AWS-managed endpoints (SageMaker/Bedrock) due to enterprise discount, IAM integration, and single-vendor procurement policy; also internal champion left and budget cap.
notes:
Lead source: conference outreach (AI Advertising Summit).
Quick summary: strong product fit for chat + reranking; wanted predictable latency for real-time bidding (sub-50ms p99). Heavy emphasis on IAM and single-vendor procurement — Procurement team prefers to consolidate spend with existing hyperscaler contract.

Recent call excerpts / paraphrase: "We like Redwood's batching and KV cache ideas, but our procurement path is through existing AWS enterprise agreement." — Head of Infra.

Pain points / what they told us:
- Need p99 <50ms for personalization path, throughput 2k rps peak.
- Must enforce company-wide IAM, centralized KMS and CloudTrail audit logs.
- Data residency: US-only for ad-targeting data.
- Budget: locked into quarterly cap until EOY; cannot sign new multi-year vendor without C-level approval.

Engagement notes (shorthand):
- 2024-05-15 inbound, initial demo planned.
- 2024-06-03 demo w/ Diego — showed dedicated capacity plan + perf numbers.
- 2024-06-12 security deep-dive (FF-3241) — security liked audit pattern but asked for native cloud KMS integration.
- 2024-07-01 pricing deck shared (drive link), asked for cost model vs SageMaker.
- 2024-08-09 procurement call: AWS legal and finance pushing for single-vendor.
- 2024-08-20 internal change: CTO left; champion gone.
- 2024-09-05 procurement notified AE that ELT approved use of AWS managed endpoints via existing discount.

Why lost: mix of factors: enterprise discount from AWS + procurement consolidation policy + no internal champion after CTO exit + short-term budget freeze prevented committing to Dedicated. They cited faster sign-off and tighter IAM/KMS integration with AWS-managed endpoints as decisive.

What we tried: trimmed Dedicated proposal, offered hybrid (Dedicated + VPC peering), offered 6-month pilot with rollback, introduced Optimize cost-savings model. Security provided side-by-side controls doc but procurement still preferred native cloud.

Next steps (internal): mark closed-lost, set reminder Q3 2025 to re-open if hyperscaler lock-in shows cost/latency pain. Keep security FAQ and cost comparison artifacts in play.

Stitched links / stubs: Fireflies FF-3241, pricing deck, security-qa doc, Jira RR-1123 escalation re: billing template.

Notes tone: choppy CRM fragments, customer friendly but constrained by procurement.
